## 简体中文

- 移除自动启动、核心切换、导入、配置应用、热更新、组件部署和直接运行时的核心 check/test 预检查；保留手动 Validate，核心自身的日志和退出错误继续直接报告。
- 移除 DNS readiness 探测、DNS/CN 模式及版本组合、端口试绑定和静态冲突预判；DNS 不可达不再阻止配置激活或触发旧配置回退。
- 移除 CN 网段及双栈出口的先验限制，以及 TUN、监听端口、DNS 和路由抽样验证对核心运行的拦截；保留实际解析、实现分派和资源归属边界。外围实际操作失败单独记录，不再据此终止正常运行的核心。
- 删除已无探测依据的核心 DNS 健康指标和状态标记，继续显示 DNS 前端运行状态及实际错误。

## English

- Remove automatic core check/test prechecks from startup, core switching, imports, configuration application, hot updates, component deployment, and direct runs. Keep manual Validate and report the core's own logs and exit errors.
- Remove DNS readiness probes, DNS/CN mode and version restrictions, trial port binds, and static port conflict checks. Unreachable DNS no longer blocks configuration activation or rolls back the selected configuration.
- Remove assumptions about CN prefixes and dual-stack uplinks, along with TUN, listener, DNS, and sampled route checks that interrupted core operation. Retain actual parsing, adapter dispatch, and resource ownership boundaries. Record peripheral operation failures separately without terminating a normally running core.
- Remove core DNS health metrics and badges that no longer have probe results. Continue showing frontend running state and actual errors.
